newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill trade - 1.27 trln rbls transferred.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill trade - 1.27 trln rbls transferred.

text.p: Government securities dealers had transferred 1.27 trillion roubles ($218.5 million) to their government securities trading system accounts before the market opened on Monday, the central bank's open-market operations department said.

Only money transferred to trading accounts before the market opens at 11 a.m. (0700 GMT) is available for investing in paper that day and is an indication of potential demand for GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds.
Average transfers are around two trillion roubles, though prices have risen recently despite much lower transfers.

The total limit for short positions available to dealers licensed to conduct repo operations remains at 2.00 trillion roubles. The rate for repos taken out on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday remains at 18 percent and for repos taken out on Thursday and Friday at 21 percent. Repos taken out on Monday will expire on August 20.
